"""Single-episode camera-guided Panda controller. Uses only rcb_client.
Actions are retained in commands.jsonl and observations in numbered directories.
Invoke pose X Y Z YAW [finger] [seconds], joints q1..q7 finger seconds, or observe.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from kinematics import ik
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def save(obs,name):
 obs.save(OUT/name)
 (OUT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps({'dir':name,'done':obs.meta['done'],'reason':obs.meta['reason'],'steps':obs.meta['control_steps'],'now':obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:23]}))

def run():
 r=Robot();s=r.spec();(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2))
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none');p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe'
 if mode=='observe':
  obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none');save(obs,f"obs_{obs.meta['calls']:04d}");return
 if mode=='pose':
  vals=list(map(float,sys.argv[2:]));x,y,z,yaw=vals[:4];finger=vals[4] if len(vals)>4 else .04;seconds=vals[5] if len(vals)>5 else 3
  rot=R.from_euler('z',yaw).as_matrix()@np.diag([1,-1,-1])
  q=ik(np.array([x,y,z]),rot,p[:7])
 elif mode=='joints':
  vals=list(map(float,sys.argv[2:]));q=np.array(vals[:7]);finger=vals[7];seconds=vals[8]
 elif mode=='grip':
  q=p[:7];finger=float(sys.argv[2]);seconds=float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 1
 n=round(seconds/.1);target=np.r_[q,finger,finger];start=np.r_[p[:7],p[14:16]]
 a=np.linspace(start,target,n+1)[1:]
 with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'argv':sys.argv[1:],'actions':a.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.1,cameras=None,video='none',include_depth=True)
 save(obs,f"move_{obs.meta['calls']:04d}")
if __name__=='__main__':run()
